topic.title: Decentralized Optimization, Communication, and Stability
topic.overview: Decentralized learning lets connected workers optimize collaboratively without routing every update through a central coordinator. This topic studies local updates, network mixing, gradient tracking, minimax objectives, and compressed communication. A representative analysis uses algorithmic stability to examine how communication topology affects generalization as well as convergence.
topic.whyItMatters: Reducing communication can save time, but disagreement between workers introduces additional error. Useful guarantees must account for data differences, graph connectivity, and the interaction between local computation and information exchange.
topic.evolution: Earlier representatives address distributed value functions and adaptive networks. Later work develops unified analyses for changing topologies and faster gradient tracking. Recent papers examine communication compression, alternative mixing matrices, and certified removal of a participant's influence using information from training trajectories.
openQuestions: How can communication schedules adapt to changing topology and heterogeneous data?
Can stability-based guarantees remain informative at the scale and nonconvexity of modern collaborative training?

papers.title: Decentralized Convex Finite-Sum Optimization with Better Dependence on Condition Numbers
papers.tldr: A decentralized variance-reduced method improves computation bounds through global conditioning while allowing node-specific mini-batch sizes.

papers.title: Double Stochasticity Gazes Faster: Snap-Shot Decentralized Stochastic Gradient Tracking Methods
papers.tldr: Two snap-shot gradient-tracking methods improve decentralized optimization, with network-dependent theoretical guarantees and supporting numerical results.

papers.title: Dynamic Byzantine-Robust Learning: Adapting to Switching Byzantine Workers
papers.tldr: DynaBRO tolerates changing faulty workers and nearly matches static-setting convergence rates when identity changes grow as O(√T).

papers.title: Faster Adaptive Decentralized Learning Algorithms
papers.tldr: AdaMDOS and AdaMDOF provide near-optimal sample-complexity guarantees for adaptive decentralized nonconvex optimization.

papers.title: Fault Tolerant ML: Efficient Meta-Aggregation and Synchronous Training
papers.tldr: CTMA and a double-momentum gradient estimator aim to make Byzantine-robust distributed training efficient and easier to tune.

papers.title: Improved Stability and Generalization Guarantees of the Decentralized SGD Algorithm
papers.tldr: Decentralized SGD matches classical SGD's generalization bounds, while a refined analysis shows that weak connectivity can sometimes help.

papers.title: Optimally Improving Cooperative Learning in a Social Setting
papers.tldr: The paper develops algorithms for improving networked classifiers and shows that aggregate and egalitarian objectives have different computational difficulty.

papers.title: The Role of Learning Algorithms in Collective Action
papers.tldr: The success of collective influence on machine learning depends strongly on the learning algorithm and its inductive biases.

papers.title: Triadic-OCD: Asynchronous Online Change Detection with Provable Robustness, Optimality, and Convergence
papers.tldr: Triadic-OCD combines robust online change detection with asynchronous distributed execution and theoretical optimality and convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Achieving Linear Convergence with Parameter-Free Algorithms in Decentralized Optimization
papers.tldr: A decentralized optimizer adapts step sizes using local information while achieving linear convergence for smooth, strongly convex objectives.

papers.title: Achieving Near-Optimal Convergence for Distributed Minimax Optimization with Adaptive Stepsizes
papers.tldr: D-AdaST coordinates adaptive step sizes across computing nodes to achieve near-optimal convergence for nonconvex, strongly concave distributed minimax problems.

papers.title: B-ary Tree Push-Pull Method is Provably Efficient for Distributed Learning on Heterogeneous Data
papers.tldr: BTPP uses two communication trees to achieve provable distributed-learning speedup with limited neighbor exchanges and a short transient period.

papers.title: Communication Bounds for the Distributed Experts Problem
papers.tldr: The paper develops communication-efficient distributed expert-selection protocols with near-optimal regret and a conditional near-optimality bound on communication.

papers.title: Does Worst-Performing Agent Lead the Pack? Analyzing Agent Dynamics in Unified Distributed SGD
papers.tldr: Long-run analysis and simulations show that a few agents with highly efficient sampling can substantially improve distributed SGD convergence.

papers.title: Freya PAGE: First Optimal Time Complexity for Large-Scale Nonconvex Finite-Sum Optimization with Heterogeneous Asynchronous Computations
papers.tldr: Freya PAGE handles unequal asynchronous workers and achieves optimal time complexity in a specified large-scale optimization regime.

papers.title: Implicit Regularization of Decentralized Gradient Descent for Sparse Regression
papers.tldr: Under sufficient conditions, decentralized gradient descent learns sparse models without explicit penalties, with a truncated variant reducing communication at high signal-to-noise ratios.

papers.title: Lower Bounds and Optimal Algorithms for Non-Smooth Convex Decentralized Optimization over Time-Varying Networks
papers.tldr: The paper establishes computation and communication lower bounds for nonsmooth decentralized convex optimization on changing networks and provides a matching optimal algorithm.

papers.title: On the Necessity of Collaboration for Online Model Selection with Decentralized Data
papers.tldr: Collaboration becomes necessary for decentralized online model selection when each client’s computation is restricted to o(K).

papers.title: On the Optimal Time Complexities in Decentralized Stochastic Asynchronous Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper derives decentralized asynchronous optimization time bounds and introduces Fragile SGD and Amelie SGD to approach or match them.

papers.title: Shadowheart SGD: Distributed Asynchronous SGD with Optimal Time Complexity Under Arbitrary Computation and Communication Heterogeneity
papers.tldr: Shadowheart SGD achieves provably optimal time complexity within centralized methods with compressed communication under heterogeneous worker speeds and communication delays.

papers.title: SPARKLE: A Unified Single-Loop Primal-Dual Framework for Decentralized Bilevel Optimization
papers.tldr: SPARKLE unifies decentralized bilevel algorithms and supports different heterogeneity corrections at each optimization level with strong convergence rates.

papers.title: Stabilized Proximal-Point Methods for Federated Optimization
papers.tldr: S-DANE preserves strong communication guarantees while allowing cheaper local solves, with accelerated and adaptive variants for distributed convex optimization.

papers.title: Weight for Robustness: A Comprehensive Approach towards Optimal Fault-Tolerant Asynchronous ML
papers.tldr: Weighted robust aggregation and variance reduction enable an optimal convergence rate in the paper’s asynchronous Byzantine learning setting.

papers.title: Achieving Linear Speedup and Near-Optimal Complexity for Decentralized Optimization over Row-stochastic Networks
papers.tldr: New convergence analysis and multi-step gossip deliver linear speedup and near-optimal complexity for decentralized optimization over row-stochastic networks.

papers.title: Decoupled SGDA for Games with Intermittent Strategy Communication
papers.tldr: Decoupled SGDA lets players update using stale opponent strategies, reducing communication especially in weakly coupled games.

papers.title: Enhancing Parallelism in Decentralized Stochastic Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: Decentralized Anytime SGD expands theoretically supported parallelism and closes the gap with centralized learning in highly connected networks.

papers.title: Exploiting Similarity for Computation and Communication-Efficient Decentralized Optimization
papers.tldr: SPDO exploits similarity between local objectives to improve both computation and communication costs in decentralized optimization.

papers.title: On the Tension between Byzantine Robustness and No-Attack Accuracy in Distributed Learning
papers.tldr: The paper proves a worst-case tradeoff between Byzantine tolerance and attack-free accuracy for robust distributed-learning aggregation.

papers.title: PDUDT: Provable Decentralized Unlearning under Dynamic Topologies
papers.tldr: PDUDT removes a client's influence without extra communication or retraining, with a perturbed-retraining guarantee and over 99% reported time savings.

papers.title: Riemannian Diffusion Adaptation for Distributed Optimization on Manifolds
papers.tldr: A decentralized diffusion strategy supports online optimization on manifolds, with network-agreement analysis and finite-iteration convergence results.

papers.title: Stability and Generalization Analysis of Decentralized SGD: Sharper Bounds Beyond Lipschitzness and Smoothness
papers.tldr: Sharper stability analysis gives decentralized SGD improved smooth-problem guarantees and optimal bounds for nonsmooth problems.

papers.title: Unified Breakdown Analysis for Byzantine Robust Gossip
papers.tldr: F-RG unifies robust decentralized learning algorithms and introduces CS+-RG, which approaches the theoretical limit on tolerated adversarial participation.

papers.title: A Near-Optimal Algorithm for Decentralized Convex-Concave Finite-Sum Minimax Optimization
papers.tldr: DIVERSE achieves near-optimal computation and communication guarantees for strongly convex–strongly concave decentralized minimax optimization.

papers.title: Revisiting 1-peer exponential graph for enhancing decentralized learning efficiency
papers.tldr: New communication graphs improve decentralized learning, with null-cascade achieving finite-time averaging convergence for any node count and commuting mixing matrices.

papers.title: Revisiting Consensus Error: A Fine-grained Analysis of Local SGD under Second-order Data Heterogeneity
papers.tldr: Refined convergence bounds explain local SGD’s advantages under low second-order heterogeneity and third-order smoothness.

papers.title: Tight analyses of first-order methods with error feedback
papers.tldr: Tight single-agent analyses of EF and EF21 establish matching convergence bounds and enable a principled comparison of compression methods.

papers.title: Tight Bounds for Maximum Weight Matroid Independent Set and Matching in the Zero Communication Model
papers.tldr: Small independent server messages suffice for exact matroid and matching optimization, with tight size bounds.

papers.title: Unveiling the Power of Multiple Gossip Steps: A Stability-Based Generalization Analysis in Decentralized Training
papers.tldr: Stability analysis explains why extra gossip steps improve decentralized training bounds while leaving a residual gap from centralized guarantees.

papers.title: A Tight Theory of Error Feedback Algorithms in Distributed Optimization
papers.tldr: Tight analyses of EF and EF21 identify optimal step sizes and recover the best known single-agent convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Accelerated Dual Method for Distributed Optimization: An Inexact-Gradient View of Local Updates
papers.tldr: An inexact-gradient analysis supports accelerated distributed optimization with local updates and conditionally optimal communication complexity.

papers.title: Bottleneck Communication Delay Minimization for Communication-Efficient Decentralized Learning
papers.tldr: BTSP-MSR approximately optimizes node assignments to reduce bottleneck communication delays in decentralized learning networks with unequal connection delays.

papers.title: Complexity of Decentralized Optimization with Mixed Affine Constraints
papers.tldr: The paper develops optimal or near-optimal decentralized optimization methods for convex problems with interacting local and global affine equality constraints.

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of the Lion Optimizer in Centralized and Distributed Settings
papers.tldr: The paper establishes convergence rates for Lion and shows how variance reduction, distributed computation, and sign compression change those guarantees.

papers.title: Distributed Direct Preference Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper analyzes distributed DPO, showing how preference differences, communication frequency, and network connectivity affect convergence.

papers.title: Distributed Stochastic $K$-Level Optimization Over Networks
papers.tldr: A variance-reduced decentralized algorithm and new convergence analysis address stochastic optimization with more than two levels.

papers.title: FAB: A First-Order AB-based Gradient Algorithm for Distributed Bilevel Optimization over Time-Varying Directed Graphs
papers.tldr: FAB combines first-order bilevel optimization with Push–Pull communication and establishes convergence results for changing directed networks.

papers.title: High-Probability Convergence Guarantees of Decentralized SGD
papers.tldr: Under light-tailed noise, decentralized SGD achieves sharp high-probability convergence and linear user-count speed-up with relaxed cost-function assumptions.

papers.title: Improved Convergence Analysis of Topology Dependence in Decentralized SGD
papers.tldr: A convergence analysis using the mixing matrix’s full spectrum better explains how communication topology affects decentralized SGD.

papers.title: Improving the Robustness-Utility Trade-off in Decentralized Learning over Sparse Networks
papers.tldr: Scaled dual updates improve convergence guarantees for Byzantine-robust decentralized learning, with stronger bounds when the attacker fraction is small.

papers.title: On the Convergence of Decentralized Stochastic Minimax Optimization Algorithm with Compressed Communication
papers.tldr: The paper develops compressed decentralized minimax optimization with error feedback and establishes how compression affects its convergence rate.

papers.title: Row-Stochastic Matrices Can Provably Outperform Doubly Stochastic Matrices in Decentralized Learning
papers.tldr: Weighted-space analysis identifies conditions where row-stochastic communication converges faster than doubly stochastic designs, even with a smaller spectral gap.

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Certified Decentralized Unlearning via SGD Stability
papers.tldr: TRACE-DU uses training trajectories, checkpoint selection, and calibrated noise for certified decentralized unlearning without requiring convex losses.
